_doc: Size + comment ratchet. New files must stay under maxNewFileLines. Listed files must not grow. Comment share per directory must not rise. Lower these numbers as the refactor lands; never raise one without a note in 'exceptions'.

exceptions.core: the ABI contract prose at the top of cliApi.h is pinned by core/tests/cliApi.test.cpp and stays; 11 -> 12 for the .stc script ABI, whose handle-owned strings are the one exception to that contract's ownership rule and have to be stated where a caller reads it
exceptions.core/format: the Port-of mappings at the top of each header stay (parity contract)
exceptions.core/geometry: the Port-of mappings at the top of each header stay (parity contract). 9 -> 10 for swapCropOrientation: the Album/Portrait press carries the user's own framing across the flip instead of resetting it, and the reciprocal-aspect fact it relies on is non-obvious enough to state.
exceptions.core/raster: the kMaxCoord/clamp hardening and the pinned-Sobel and two-phase notes stay

_dirsNote: A test folder mirrors the source it covers, and a doctest TU that spans modules has no one home, so core/tests is frozen at today's count rather than split by kind.
